name: s81fill2_host_c-g1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 FILL-S2: die master dsfd_host_c (1 replicas, hardened once): exact lockstep bench + failing mutant; recipe 2, M5 cap, GEN19b pins evenly spread

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_host_c #(.NS(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DDSFD_HOST_C_STATIC --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_c.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_sd.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_native.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/ot_s81_ingest_visibility_fence.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ctrl/ot_s81_secded.sv physical/rom_host_ingest/rtl/dsfd_host.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_rom_host_ingest.sv rtl/link/ot_link_afifo.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_hdc_kv_ingest.sv rtl/hdc/ingest/ot_hdc_ingest_fp8q.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81fill2_host_c/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81fill2_host_c/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81fill2_host_c --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_host_c  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: First hardening of the S81 die master dsfd_host_c (1 die instances, static layer-die host (+DSFD_HOST_C_STATIC, S-BIND r6: no credit bits, collective host face 515/77, lane-fault fold; host ingest + per-stack writes; program words cross ck->ckv). The generator reservation 1727.976 x 129.576 puts hw/hc/f_lf at its W end and the collective/sequencer faces at its E end with the clocks spread 848..1624 um: one compact block (no > 600-um clock root) and the die relays the 292-b host-write lane (slot change request)); real RTL rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ingest/dsfd_host_c.sv (exact lockstep gate rtl/v41die/test/tb_ot_s81_cfg7_seq.sv); 0 cycles; pins = GEN19b construction_pass2 (EPYC4 s81-die-r10/gen19b, pins.lef) order with the shared fixes: even per-face spread (generator packed W-face M4 pins at 0.048 um = 20.8 b/um/layer > 12), clock at face centre, no output hold pads; outline 1727.976x129.576 -> 453.6x71.28 (2.16 lattice).
